description: This class, MetadataHeadersValueValidator, is a final, immutable Java class responsible for validating string values against the MetadataHeaders data structure. It parses a CharSequence to MetadataHeaders and throws a detailed exception if parsing fails.

classes.name: MetadataHeadersValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton immutable class that validates CharSequence values by parsing them into MetadataHeaders, throwing detailed exceptions on failure.
